_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score-band Hope coil with non-extended funding/MVRV and flat momentum favors staying on the rung until momentum or flows break the range.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative only implies softer demand via intake drop, no phase/direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, 30d momentum near 50, Fear & Greed low-to-mid 60s, no funding spike
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum through 70 with rising funding, or CVD rollover and Fear & Greed under 50
